identity.fantasy: A vengeful glaive skirmisher who marks enemies in melee, spends stars through arcane blades, and teleports through targets during lunar pursuit windows.
identity.one_line: A mobile glaive fighter that applies Stars in melee, spends them through Starsunder and Astral Blade, and teleports through targets during Avatar of Vengeance. It blends Intellect scaling, short-range AoE, and pursuit tools, giving it a strong PvP/skirmisher shape.

mechanics.core_loop: Build Scattered Stars through the melee package, use Lunar Lance as the reported setup point, spend with Starsunder and Astral Blade, and exploit Shattered Stars procs while using Lunar Charge, Lethal Pursuit, and Avatar of Vengeance to stay attached.
mechanics.single_target: A current post-update sequence reportedly builds to eight stars, uses Lunar Lance, then spends through repeated Starsunder while arcane Shattered Stars procs supply much of the payoff.
mechanics.aoe: Fan of Knives, Sentinel Glaive, Astral Blade, and star effects provide short-range coverage, but current discussion places Warden's relative strength more clearly in single target than Moon Guard-style area damage.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Lunar Charge, Lethal Pursuit, and Avatar of Vengeance create an aggressive gap-closing and teleport identity well suited to skirmishes.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Pursuit tools, Starcaller control, and Aspect of the Moonwell resource cycling help sustain pressure, though the spec still pays normal melee exposure costs.
mechanics.group_utility: Mobile target pressure and Starcaller control are its clearest contributions beyond damage.

failure_modes.text: Spending stars before the intended setup or losing contact during the proc and pursuit window reduces the payoff of an otherwise compact sequence.

append_claims.text: An August post-update Warden discussion recommends building to eight stars, using Lunar Lance, then repeatedly spending with Starsunder. It advises a slow main hand and fast off hand for procs, says much of the damage comes from Arcane Shattered Stars, and characterizes Warden as stronger at single target than Moon Guard while also calling the surface loop boring or two-spell.
append_claims.notes: Advice was posted immediately after an update and may still be settling.

append_claims.text: Starcaller discussions split on Warden: some players find the small apparent loop dull, while PvP-focused reports say Aspect of the Moonwell resolves mana flow and makes its mobile star-spender gameplay strong and fun.
append_claims.notes: The split likely reflects both content type and patch timing.

append_claims.text: The July DPS compilation reports Warden at 4,080, and the August Mythic inventory lists 174 Warden records.
append_claims.notes: The performance sources lack normalization and should not be read as a tier ranking.

append_claims.text: Warden's small realized sequence still carries meaningful timing cost because premature star spending or lost melee contact can reduce the Lunar Lance, Starsunder, and Shattered Stars conversion window.
append_claims.notes: Exact star thresholds and proc conversion require current live verification.

append_claims.text: Current PvE advice builds scattered stars, triggers Lunar Lance, then uses Starsunder; dual wield and Warden Aspect favor single targets while Moonwell favors AoE, but stat and weapon advice still conflicts.
append_claims.notes: Manually reviewed on 2026-08-06; anecdotal evidence is not treated as a power ranking.
